original_text:
Grokking was introduced by Power et al.\ \citeyear{power2022grokking}, who
observed that networks trained on small algorithmic datasets would memorise
first and generalise much later, with the delay sensitive to weight decay and
training fraction.

rationale: The cited paper originally demonstrated grokking specifically on small algorithmic datasets; dropping this condition over-generalises the finding to imply they observed it across networks and tasks unconditionally.
ground_truth_description: Dropped the explicitly qualifying condition 'trained on small algorithmic datasets' from the summary of the Power et al. (2022) results.
